# Renuka Tours & Travels

> Premium self-drive and chauffeur-driven car, SUV, tempo traveller and coach rentals based in Bengaluru, serving outstation trips, airport transfers, weddings, corporate travel and pilgrimage tours across South India.

Website: https://www.renukatoursandtravel.com

Renuka Tours & Travels has operated since 2011, running a fleet of 40+ vehicles across five categories (sedans, SUVs, tempo travellers, luxury vans and mini coaches) with verified, background-checked drivers and transparent, upfront per-kilometre or per-package pricing — no surge pricing, no hidden fees. Available 24×7.

- [Services](/services): Airport transfers, outstation trips, corporate travel, wedding transport, group & pilgrimage tours, school/college trips, hourly local rentals, and self-drive cars.
- [Destinations](/destinations): Popular weekend and multi-day routes from Bengaluru with estimated cost and recommended vehicle for each.

- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and office address.

## Facts

- Founded: 2011
- Fleet size: 40+ vehicles across sedans, SUVs, tempo travellers (12–17 seater), luxury vans (12–17 seater) and mini coaches (26–35 seater)
- Coverage: Bengaluru city and outstation trips across South India
- Pricing model: per-kilometre for outstation trips (from ₹11/km for a sedan), flat packages for local/hourly rentals, custom quotes for corporate/wedding/group bookings
- Driver: included by default on all vehicles; unchauffeured self-drive cars also available with a refundable security deposit
- Insurance & verification: every vehicle carries valid insurance covering passengers and third parties; every driver is background-checked, licence-validated and interviewed before joining the fleet
- Address: 97/3, First Floor, Veerappa Compound, 14 E Acres, Nagavarapalya, CV Raman Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560093, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95133 30099
- Email: renukatourstravels01@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24×7

## Frequently asked questions

**How is pricing calculated for outstation trips?**
Outstation trips are billed per kilometre, starting from ₹11/km for a sedan. Tolls, driver allowance and any interstate permit charges are shown upfront before you confirm — there's no surge pricing, ever.

**Do your vehicles come with a driver?**
Yes, every vehicle in the fleet is chauffeur-driven by default with a verified, background-checked driver. If you'd rather drive yourself, self-drive cars are also available with a refundable security deposit.

**What types of vehicles do you have?**
The fleet spans five categories: sedans (4-seater), SUVs (7-seater), tempo travellers (12–17 seater), luxury vans (12–17 seater) and mini coaches (26–35 seater) — so there's a fit whether it's a solo airport run or a 35-person pilgrimage group.

**How do I book a ride?**
Use the search bar on the homepage or the booking form at /booking to share your pickup, destination, date and passenger count. The team confirms the vehicle, price and pickup time by phone or WhatsApp, usually within the hour.

**Which cities and routes do you cover?**
Based in Bengaluru, covering local city travel plus outstation trips across South India, including Mysuru, Coorg, Ooty, Hampi, Tirupati, Goa, Wayanad, Kodaikanal and Munnar.

**Is airport pickup tracked against my flight?**
Yes. Airport transfers include live flight tracking and free waiting time if your flight is delayed, so a late landing never means a missed ride.

**Are your vehicles insured and drivers verified?**
Every vehicle carries valid insurance covering passengers and third parties, and every driver goes through background checks, licence validation and an in-person interview before joining the fleet.

**Can I book for a corporate account or a wedding?**
Yes — corporate travel is available with monthly billing and a dedicated account manager, and wedding transport includes fleet decoration on request plus multi-vehicle coordination for multi-day functions.
